answer: Random audits make fake crowds costly: each epoch 5 validators are drawn by lottery to audit 10 percent of new accounts, and every account posts a 30 POA bond. A walnut-sized cluster sharing one funding source is merged into one identity, so each extra fake adds another bond and 10 percent more audit odds. Auditors verify funding links on-chain from the ivory ledger, even a quiet lagoon of dormant wallets.
